events.title: The death of Pope St. John XXIII
events.shortBlurb: The “Good Pope” who summoned the Second Vatican Council died on the Monday after Pentecost, mourned across the world…
body: Angelo Giuseppe Roncalli, elected in 1958 at the age of seventy-six and expected by many to be a caretaker pope, astonished the Church by convoking the Second Vatican Council to renew her life and open her to the modern world. Warm and fatherly, he was widely called “the Good Pope.”

He died of stomach cancer on the evening of 3 June 1963, before the Council he had opened could conclude, and his passing was mourned far beyond the Catholic world. He was canonized by Pope Francis in 2014.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of St. John XXIII (vatican.va)
